en.sayed-ali-raza: Take care of the affairs of those of them who do not approach you among those who are looked at with contempt and whom people regard as low.
Appoint for them some trusted people who are God-fearing and humble. They should infrom you of these people’s conditions.

Then deal with them with a sense of responsibility to Allāh on the day you will meet Him, because of all the subjects these people are the most deserving of equitable treatment, while for others also you should fulfil their rights so as to render account to Allāh.
